data.body:
[P2] Preserve newer requests when rerunning an old event

If an author push is processed successfully, a maintainer then reapplies `changes-requested`, and the original run is rerun, both `labels` and `event_labels` contain `changes-requested`. This condition removes the newer request and returns the PR to `needs-review` without another author update. Label-name snapshots cannot distinguish separate applications of the same label. Pass ordering metadata for the original event and verify that the latest matching `labeled` timeline entry predates it before removing the label. Add a regression test covering removal, reapplication, and rerun.
